dict.string: on alfred_script(q) set h to "/etc/profiles/per-user/$USER/bin/herdr" do shell script "p=$(" & h & " tab create --focus --label alfred | /usr/bin/plutil -extract result.root_pane.pane_id raw -o - -) && " & h & " pane run \"$p\" " & quoted form of q tell application "Herdr" to activate end alfred_script
